title: DeviceModel
description: A display device model: technology → family (the protocol an adapter speaks) → model. FiestaUI's src/lib/devices.ts is the source of truth (validateDeviceModel mirrors this schema and is tested to agree with it); a FiestaBoard output plugin declares one in its manifest and owns the transport.

geometry.description: An led_matrix model is measured in pixels.

then.description: A model offering a face choice declares its own face.
A 3x5 model offering a face choice draws led_3x5, and offers its own face.
A 5x7 model offering a face choice draws led_5x7, and offers its own face.
A split-flap board has no LED layout, so it declares no layoutOptions.

charsetByCode62.description: For a model whose code-62 flap varies by board: the set per glyph.

maxFrames.description: Hard budget for a sequence player: a transition is compressed into at most this many frames, first to final inclusive.

notes.description: Research prose: what the API does and its risks. Fixture and plugin data carry it; FiestaUI's runtime built-ins leave it out.

layoutOptions.description: LED only. CHANGES DEVICE BYTES (unlike appearance): which values of the LED layout options a board on this model may choose, and its default. A tileGap or blockPadding left out is unrestricted — every value allowed, the renderer's default (tileGap "gap", blockPadding 0) — so a plugin published before the options existed renders exactly as before. `default` must be one of `allowed`; left out, it is the renderer's default when allowed, else the first allowed value. tileGap "fill" lights the 1-px gutter between two same-colour lit fields (tiles, blocks); blockPadding 1 extends a block's field one pixel into the gutters and margin. The exact pixel rules are the design spec's §7.6 and FiestaUI's layoutLedCells.

font.description: The faces a board may be set in (FiestaBoard's per-board text size: 5x7 Large, 3x5 Small). Unlike tileGap and blockPadding, leaving it out allows only the model's own `font`. Declared, `allowed` must include the model's `font`, the model must declare `font`, and its `charset` must be the built-in set drawn in that face (led_5x7 for 5x7, led_3x5 for 3x5): a board's set is derived from its face, so an inline or custom set cannot offer a choice. `default` is the face a NEW board gets and may differ from the model's `font`, which stays the face an older consumer (or a board that chose nothing) draws in.

appearance.description: PREVIEW-ONLY: how the device looks in a preview. Nothing here ever reaches the bytes a device is sent — font, letter case and monochrome are layout options, not appearance. The plugin owns the defaults; a board may override only the fields `options` lists.

pixelShape.description: LED: how a lit pixel reads — a bare LED is round, a diffused face square.

dotRatio.description: LED: the lit dot's diameter as a fraction of the pixel pitch.

substrateColor.description: The panel substrate (soldermask) or board face behind the pixels or flaps.

bezel.description: The bezel around the display. Unset: the preview's theme bezel.

boardColors.description: Split-flap: the housing colours the board ships in; the first is the default.

options.description: The fields a board may override, each with its allowed values, e.g. { "board_color": ["black", "white"] }. Keys are the board setting names.

charsetRef.description: A built-in set id, or an embedded CharacterSet.
